hook: Nights to run *2-3°C* below normal; health dept flags flu risk
hook_b: Nights to run *2-3°C* below normal; health dept flags flu risk
tldr: IMD forecasts dry weather and minimum temperatures 2°C to 3°C below normal across Telangana for the next two days, and the State Health Department has issued a seasonal flu advisory.

beats.what: Director of Public Health B. Ravinder Nayak warned the dip could favour seasonal flu and raise acute respiratory infections, per The Hindu.
beats.why: Colder minimum temperatures can favour the spread of seasonal flu, the advisory says.
beats.care: Pregnant women, children under 5, people over 65 and those with chronic illness are flagged as high-risk and told to see a doctor if symptoms start.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Warning signs needing immediate care: high fever, breathing difficulty, bluish lips or skin, blood in sputum. Dial 108 for an ambulance.

cards.q: How are you handling the colder nights?

qs: Will flu cases rise at government hospitals this week?
Who checks that special beds and medicines are in place?

facts.t: Most flu patients are expected to recover *within a week*, the advisory says.

steps.e: See a doctor at nearest facility

viz.verdict: Precaution advice for the next two colder days
Colder nights raise flu risk, says the health dept

watch: Minimum temperatures over the next two days and any rise in flu cases at government hospitals.
